description: Punts Wifi / Puntos Wifi is a dataset listed in Valencia open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de València. Ubicación de redes wifi públicas. Coverage: Valencia. The portal files it under Urban planning and infraestructure. Its keywords are Public and state utility services. The portal shows 298 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-08-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valencia-portal.
